en.name: Innocent II
en.summary: A pope whose contested election against the antipope Anacletus II was ultimately upheld with the crucial support of Bernard of Clairvaux.
en.body: Innocent II's election was immediately disputed by a rival faction backing Anacletus II, splitting Western Christendom's allegiance for years until the influential Cistercian abbot Bernard of Clairvaux championed Innocent's cause across France, Germany, and England, swinging decisive support his way. Innocent presided over the Second Lateran Council in 1139, which formally healed the schism's aftermath and issued extensive reform legislation.
